answer: Blessed clinic matron licence with nursing council attestation turns identity into something scarce. Because a licence the council renews after ward audits, the gale of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. A clone farm can generate keys forever, but it cannot generate a licence the council renews after ward audits a hundred times without paying a hundred times over, and the pigment of that asymmetry is what keeps the network honest. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the violet is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
